issues.evidence: Tibetan lists two separate epithets, "གསལ་བྱེད་སྒྲོན་མ" (illuminator, lamp); bo-mipham 4-45 glosses "གསལ་བྱེད་དུ་གྱུར་པ" (becoming the illuminator, by teaching person-selflessness) separately from "ཆོས་ཀྱི་སྒྲོན་མ་ཆེན་པོ" (the lamp, by teaching phenomena-selflessness). The Chinese fuses them into one "照明之燈", dropping the separate item.

issues.span: 具不退轉、無動搖與不傾動之法性
issues.evidence: Tibetan ends "མི་ལྡོག་གཡོ་བ་མེད་ཅིང་མི་འཁྲུགས་ཆོས་ཅན་ཡིན"; "ཆོས་ཅན" (Skt. -dharmāḥ) here means 'of such a nature / possessing' (bo-mipham 4-46: "མི་འཁྲུགས་པའི་ཆོས་ཅན་ཡིན"; bo-rangjung 4-46: "ཡོན་ཏན་གྱི་ཆོས་ཁྱད་པར་ཅན་དང་ལྡན་པས..."), not dharmatā. 法性 is the locked rendering of ཆོས་ཉིད, so using it here suggests a different term, and it makes 'irreversible' and 'unwavering' appear as a 'nature' rather than predicates of the subjects.
issues.fix: 不退轉、無動搖，且為不可擾動之本性者

issues.evidence: Tibetan "ཐུགས་ཁྲལ་ཆུང་བར་མཛད" means he became reluctant or little disposed to teach; bo-mipham 4-48: "ཆོས་སྟོན་པ་ལ་ཐུགས་ཁྲལ་ཆུང་བར་མཛད" (little inclination toward teaching the Dharma); Skt. "alpotsuko". "少顧念" can be read as 'cared little about beings', which contradicts the compassionate benefactor named in the same verse.
